boundaries: A policy file does not activate itself or grant governance authority.
Changing a permission or guard creates a successor version with review and test evidence.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One challenge deployment and policy version.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Application Access Policy meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It is the complete rulebook the app checks before reading or changing protected data.

boundary_conditions: A policy file does not activate itself or grant governance authority.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: An Application Access Policy is an immutable versioned set of Access Permissions, default-deny rules, separation-of-duties constraints and evaluation order selected for one deployment and protocol scope.
